text: RGTI is down over 51% with revenue actually declining and trading 72% below its yearly high — the thesis is broken and this position should be closed.
QBTS is down 40% and 60% below its yearly high with no earnings or revenue to justify holding full size — reduce exposure meaningfully.
AeroVironment is down 38%, has missed earnings three times in a row, and carries high short interest near 20% — trim this position until the trend reverses.
Gold Royalty is just 0.4% from its yearly low with three consecutive earnings misses and a 30% loss — reduce this position before it reaches a new low.
American Electric Power has confirmed a stage transition and VCP breakout pattern, with a strong tailwind from rising electricity demand — this is a high-conviction new entry.
